title: 听力挑战 · 文献翻译协作

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: We have divided the literature into sections, and each member is responsible for one chapter.
rounds.lineCn: 我们已把文献分成若干部分,每位成员负责一章。

grammar.name: 现在完成时 + 分工表达
grammar.note: have divided 强调分工已完成;be responsible for 是表达任务分配的标准搭配。

options.text: Each member handles one chapter of the literature.
options.feedback: 成员分工明确:每人负责一章。

options.text: One member translates the whole literature alone.
options.feedback: 文献已按章节分工,并非一人承担全部。

options.text: The literature was never divided among the members.
options.feedback: 原文说明分工已经完成。

rounds.speaker: 组长
rounds.line: Please keep the terminology consistent throughout the project so that the final version reads smoothly.
rounds.lineCn: 请在整个项目中保持术语一致,这样最终版本读起来才流畅。

grammar.name: 目的状语从句 so that
grammar.note: so that 引导目的状语从句(让终稿流畅);keep...consistent 是术语统一的标准表达。

options.text: Terminology should remain consistent in the whole project.
options.feedback: 组长要求全程统一术语。

options.text: Each translator may choose different terms freely.
options.feedback: 组长强调的正是术语一致,不能各行其是。

options.text: The final version will be polished by another team.
options.feedback: 组长希望靠统一术语保证终稿流畅,并非外包润色。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: I found some technical terms that are hard to translate, so I will mark them for group discussion.
rounds.lineCn: 我遇到一些很难翻译的术语,所以会把它们标出来供小组讨论。

grammar.name: 定语从句 + 结果状语
grammar.note: that are hard to translate 修饰 terms;so 连接结果,标记是为了集体讨论解决。

options.text: He will mark the difficult terms for group discussion.
options.feedback: 难译术语会被标注出来供小组讨论。

options.text: He will translate the difficult terms without telling anyone.
options.feedback: 他是标注出来集体讨论,不是私下处理。

options.text: He will delete the difficult terms from the translation.
options.feedback: 原文没有删词的意思,而是标记讨论。

rounds.speaker: 组长
rounds.line: After we finish the translation, we will compare it with the original text to check accuracy.
rounds.lineCn: 翻译完成后,我们会把它与原文对照,检查准确性。

grammar.name: 时间状语从句 + 不定式表目的
grammar.note: After we finish 是时间状语从句;to check accuracy 是不定式表目的,体现翻译质检流程。

options.text: The translation will be checked against the original text.
options.feedback: 译完后要与原文对照检查准确性。

options.text: The original text will be discarded after translation.
options.feedback: 原文是拿来对照检查的,不会丢弃。

options.text: Accuracy is not important in this project.
options.feedback: 检查准确性正是组长强调的环节。
